Lucy: FYI customer (FinX) wants a PoC demo next Tues using a hybrid Gaudi + MI300 cluster. They want marketplace listing + SI on-call during demo. Who's picking up marketplace and SI preflight?
Diego: I can own marketplace listing sync. Need final SKU names and availability windows.
Samir: Solutions can handle SI on-call and run the end-to-end test. When's the demo window exactly?
Lucy: Tentative demo 2026-06-29 16:00 PT. Customer may push earlier. We need: marketplace published, driver/kernel smoke, SI runbook, and a fallback model (H100) in case of perf issues.
Olga: Eng note: MI300 drivers have a microcode patch that lands this week; kernel build/test still needs 48h verification. Also Gaudi driver v2.1 is stable but we need ABI checks for mixed infra.
Samir: For SI runbook I'll draft a checklist: customer credentials, network routes, LB sticky session test, KV cache warmup, perf baselines. Want to include a small canary script:
Samir: ```
# canary perf check
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_TOKEN' -d '{"model":"mix-gaudi-mi300","prompt":"latency-test"}'
``` 
Diego: Marketplace asks for a release window note and embargo timing. Proposal: publish listing in 'preview' mode 48h before demo, public announce only after PoC signoff. OK?
Lucy: Agree. @Samir can you own the 48h smoke run and confirm fallback H100 image is available? Also ensure compliance checklist is attached.
Samir: I will run 48h smoke, starting Fri 6/26. I'll post results in this thread.
Olga: I'll coordinate kernel tests and provide image tags. Current candidate tags: gaudi:v2.1-rc3, mi300:v1.4-hotfix. Will tag to marketplace once passed.
DeployBot: deployment scheduled: preview-listing/mix-gaudi-mi300 -> 2026-06-27T03:00Z (automated). :robot_face:
Diego: I'll draft the marketplace copy and SI contact matrix, pinging partners for capacity confirmation. ETA by EOD Thurs.
Lucy: Thanks — next steps: Samir run smoke, Olga finish kernel checks, Diego prepare listing copy & embargo window. Sync Fri 10am PT for final go/no-go.
Samir: Got it. I'll put a calendar invite and include SI on-call rotation.
Lucy: :thumbsup:
